vidyā.en: knowledge; in this Upaniṣad, the worship of deities

avidyā.en: ignorance; in this Upaniṣad, ritual works

sambhūti.en: coming into being; here, the manifest

asambhūti.en: the unborn; here, unmanifest nature, the cause of the world
asambhūti.hi: जो उत्पन्न न हुआ हो; यहाँ अव्यक्त प्रकृति

asambhava.hi: जो उत्पन्न न हो; यहाँ अव्यक्त प्रकृति
